# The Shattering

The Shattering was a cataclysmic war that fundamentally transformed the political and geographical landscape of the realm. This event saw the rise of the [[factions/crimson_order]] under the command of [[characters/voss]].

## Causes

The conflict erupted from a combination of regional tensions, resource disputes, and power struggles between competing factions. What began as isolated skirmishes quickly escalated into a realm-wide conflagration.

## Consequences

The war resulted in the collapse of the old order and the emergence of new powers. The Crimson Order's military superiority during this period allowed them to consolidate unprecedented territorial gains and influence.
